results.title: What is a Framework in Programming and Engineering?
results.content:
### Framework vs. library

Both frameworks and libraries are reusable code written by someone else that help developers build applications more efficiently. However, a library is a collection of utilities or functions that the application code calls when required. Libraries are task-specific, such as enabling ML implementations with already-written codes. The library acts as a helper and tool to your application.
